validation_ai_review.summary: Bundle prep-contract looks complete and internally consistent: artifacts present (filelist, Tcl, SDC, README, top_module.txt), filelist resolves to existing RTL, selected top is ddr4_controller_top (not a testbench/harness, has normal ports), and there are no interface ports at the top boundary (so no interface-wrapper blocker). Remaining items are non-blocking robustness/portability suggestions (library search path coverage, single-clock SDC assumptions, and potential SV feature sensitivity depending on Genus version).
warnings: Top-selection indirection is consistent (top_module.txt + env(TOP) override + elaborate $TOP). No action needed; just note that top_module.txt includes a trailing newline—your Tcl trims it correctly.

Starter SDC assumes a single top-level clock port named 'clk' and reset 'rst_n'. This matches README detection, but if the real integration uses additional clocks/resets or different names, Genus will elaborate fine but timing reports will be misleading until constraints are updated.

run_genus_mc.tcl sets init_lib_search_path based only on the first GENUS_LIBS entry’s directory. If GENUS_LIBS points to libs spread across multiple directories, library loading may fail unless the user adds search paths or uses absolute paths.

RTL contains SystemVerilog features that may be tool/version sensitive for some Genus setups (e.g., packed structs, array-of-struct memories, $countones, casts like REQUEST_WIDTH'(req_mem[j])). This is not a prep completeness issue, but be aware if bring-up hits parser/semantic errors on older toolchains.
